general.notes: Technology listed as Grey CFP; four CWDM lanes @ 10Gbps for Ethernet, SDH/SONET, or OTN. Bit rates: 39.813–43.018 Gbps aggregated (footnote 1); 9.95–11.3 Gbps per lane (footnote 2). Transmitter/receiver power values are average power (footnote 3). Minimum input power and overload specified at BER 1x10-12, PRBS 2^31-1 @ 10.31 Gbps per lane (footnote 4). Power budget 0–6.7 dB. Per-lane TX output Min -7.0 dBm / Max +2.3 dBm; total TX output Max +8.3 dBm. Transmission media stated as SM (2x LC). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C (not normal operating range). Protocol support includes 40GbE, STM-256/OC768, OTU3.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether post_fec_ber_target should be recorded when only 'BER 1x10-12' is given without explicit FEC. Emitter and photodetector types are absent. Host/media interface IDs and modulation format are not in this excerpt.
